listenings.text: Good afternoon, and welcome to the store. We have a few things to tell you this afternoon. All dresses on the first floor are thirty percent off until Sunday. Shoes are on the second floor, and they are not in the sale this week. If you want to try something on, the fitting rooms are at the back, on your right, and there is no limit of pieces. If you need a different size or a different color, please ask any person with a green shirt. We are happy to look in the back for you. And if you buy something today and you change your mind, you can return it in thirty days, with the tag and the receipt. Thank you for shopping with us.

Hello, this is a message from the store on Oxford Street, for Patricia. You asked us about the blue dress in a large size. Good news: it arrived this morning, and I have one here for you. I keep it at the desk with your name on it until Friday. If you come, please ask for Ryan, and bring the receipt of the black one if you want to change it. One more thing you asked about: the shoes are now in the sale, so they are sixty pounds and not eighty. If Friday is not possible for you, call us and we keep the dress for one more week. Thank you, and see you soon.

extra_audio.text: Excuse me. How much is this dress? Do you have it in another color? Can I try it on, please? Thank you very much.

reading.rtitle: Before You Come In -- Notice in the Window
paras: Welcome. Please read this before you come in. It answers the three questions almost everybody asks.

All the prices are on the tag, and the tag is always on the left side of the piece. The first number is the price. Under the price you find the size: S is small, M is medium, L is large. If your size is not on the shelf, do not go away — ask us, because we have more in the back.
You can try on as many pieces as you want. The fitting rooms are at the back of the store, on the right. There is no limit and there is no cost.
If you buy something and you change your mind, you can return it in thirty days. Bring the tag and the receipt. The staff wear green shirts, and we are happy to speak slowly for our visitors.

To explain how to get a job in the store
